source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 5 ki exercise (PDF 116-118) ka hal; MCQs ki key chapter se, sawalon ke model jawab aur numericals qadam ba qadam.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Solids and Fluid Dynamics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; numericals mein Given, formula, qeematein aur jawab unit ke saath line ba line likhe hain. Jahan zaroorat hai "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai, aur kitab ki ghaltiyan "Kitab ki ghalti" box mein.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
5.1 The region of stress-strain curve which obeys Hooke's law is:
(Stress-strain curve ka kaun sa hissa Hooke's law ko follow karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Curve ka seedha hissa OA, proportional limit A tak, Hooke's law follow karta hai: strain stress ke directly proportional (barabar nisbat mein) hota hai. A se B tak yeh nisbat qaim nahi rehti.

blocks.prompt:
5.2 Which of the following is more elastic?
(In mein se kaun zyada elastic hai?)
blocks.explanation: Steel ka Young's modulus bohat bara hai (200 × 10⁹ N m⁻², Table 5.1). Thori si strain ke liye bohat zyada stress chahiye aur force hatane par yeh poori tarah apni asal shakal mein wapas aa jata hai, is liye physics mein steel zyada elastic hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aam zindagi mein hum rubber ko "elastic" kehte hain kyun ke woh zyada khinchta hai. Physics mein elasticity ka matlab hai deformation (shakal ki tabdeeli) ka mukable karna aur poori tarah wapas aana. Steel ko khenchna mushkil hai aur woh poora wapas aata hai, is liye woh zyada elastic hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.3 Which of the following is polymer solid?
(In mein se kaun polymer solid hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wool lambi chain wale molecules se bana qudrati (natural) polymer hai. Glass amorphous solid hai, jab ke sodium chloride aur copper crystalline solids hain (5.1).

blocks.prompt:
5.4 The effect of decrease of pressure with the increase in speed of a fluid in horizontal pipe is:
(Horizontal pipe mein fluid ki speed barhne se pressure kam hone ka effect kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Horizontal pipe ke liye Bernoulli's equation P + ½ρv² = constant ban jati hai: jahan speed zyada, wahan pressure kam (5.12). Yahi effect pipe ke tang hisse mein Venturi meter mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.5 The pressure will be low when speed of a fluid is:
(Fluid ki speed kaisi ho to pressure kam hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Bernoulli's principle ke mutabiq horizontal pipe mein P + ½ρv² = constant hai, is liye jahan fluid ki speed zyada ho wahan pressure kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.6 As per law of fluid friction for steady streamline flow, the friction:
(Steady streamline flow mein fluid friction ke qanoon ke mutabiq friction:)

options.text: fluid ki velocity ke directly proportional hoti hai
pressure ke inversely proportional hoti hai
pehle barhti phir kam hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Aahista (streamline) flow mein fluid friction (drag) velocity ke directly proportional hoti hai, jaise Stokes' law F = 6πηrv (5.13).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) bhi streamline flow mein fluid friction ka sahi qanoon hai (friction pressure par depend nahi karti), yani do options sahi chhape hain. Chapter sirf velocity wali baat (Stokes' law F = 6πηrv) deta hai, is liye (a) ko jawab liya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.7 If a stone is submerged in water and it weighs less in water than in air, this phenomenon is due to:
(Pathar pani mein hawa ke muqable mein halka lagta hai; yeh kis wajah se hai?)

options.text: pani mein mass kam ho jana
gravitational force ka oopar ki taraf amal

blocks.explanation: Pani oopar ki taraf buoyant force (upthrust) lagata hai jo hataye gaye pani ke weight ke barabar hoti hai (Archimedes' principle). Is liye pathar ka weight kam lagta hai (apparent loss of weight); us ka mass nahi badalta.

blocks.prompt:
5.8 The principle of floatation is a direct application of:
(Principle of floatation kis ka seedha application hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tairti hui cheez apne weight ke barabar fluid hatati hai; yeh seedha Archimedes' principle (upthrust = hataye gaye fluid ka weight) se nikalta hai (5.7).

blocks.prompt:
5.9 An ideal flow of any fluid must satisfy:
(Kisi bhi fluid ka ideal flow kin cheezon ko poora karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ideal flow (incompressible, non-viscous, steady) equation of continuity (mass ka conservation) aur Bernoulli's equation (energy ka conservation) dono ko poora karta hai, is liye (d) sahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.10 The lift force experienced by an aeroplane wings is primarily due to:
(Aeroplane ke wings par lift force zyada tar kis wajah se hoti hai?)

options.text: wing ke oopar aur neeche pressure ka farq

blocks.explanation: Wing ki curved oopri satah par hawa tez chalti hai, is liye wahan pressure neeche se kam hota hai. Yeh pressure ka farq wing ko oopar dhakelta hai (5.12).

blocks.prompt:
5.11 In medical field, a venture mask, used to deliver a known oxygen concentration to patients operates is based on:
(Medical field mein Venturi mask, jo mareez ko oxygen ki maloom miqdar deta hai, kis par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Venturi mask mein oxygen tang raste se tez speed se guzarti hai; wahan pressure kam ho jata hai (Bernoulli's principle) aur kamre ki hawa andar khinch aati hai, is liye oxygen aur hawa ek muqarrar nisbat mein milti hain.

blocks.prompt:
5.12 Which of the following is a defining characteristic of a superfluid?
(Superfluid ki pehchan wali khasiyat kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Superfluidity ka matlab hai zero viscosity: fluid baghair friction aur baghair kinetic energy khoye behta hai (5.16).

blocks.prompt:
5.1 What is meant by (i) cohesive forces (ii) viscosity?
(i) Cohesive forces aur (ii) viscosity se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cohesive forces: ek hi cheez ke molecules (atoms ya ions) ke darmiyan kashish (attraction) ki forces. Yeh solid ke particles ko apni jagah aur liquid ko jora hua rakhti hain.
(ii) Viscosity: behte fluid ki layers ke darmiyan friction (ragar); yani ek layer ko doosri par sarkane ke liye kitni force chahiye. Is ka nishan η hai (shahad ki viscosity zyada, pani ki kam).

blocks.prompt:
5.2 Differentiate between streamline and turbulent flow of a fluid.
Fluid ke streamline aur turbulent flow mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Streamline flow mein har particle ek hi hamwar (smooth) raasta chalta hai; turbulent flow be-tarteeb (irregular) hota hai.

rows: Har particle pichhle particles wala raasta hi chalta hai
Be-tarteeb flow; particles ke raaste badalte rehte hain
Streamlines ek doosre ko cross nahi karti
Lines cross hoti hain; eddies (bhanwar) bante hain
Kisi point par velocity waqt ke saath nahi badalti
Ek khaas speed se oopar hota hai

blocks.prompt:
5.3 How does pressure changes with depth in fluids?
Fluids mein gehrai (depth) ke saath pressure kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluid mein gehrai ke saath pressure barhta hai: P = ρgh, jahan h surface se neeche gehrai hai (surface par atmospheric pressure is ke ilawa). Jitna neeche jayen, oopar fluid ka weight utna zyada, is liye pressure bhi zyada.

blocks.prompt:
5.4 How is variation in pressure related to speed of a fluid?
Pressure ki tabdeeli fluid ki speed se kaise judi hai?
blocks.explanation:
Horizontal pipe ke liye Bernoulli's equation: P + ½ρv² = constant. Is liye jahan speed zyada wahan pressure kam, aur jahan speed kam wahan pressure zyada:
P₁ − P₂ = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²).

blocks.prompt:
5.5 How the flow rate is related to the cross-sectional area and velocity of the fluid?
Flow rate ka cross-sectional area aur fluid ki velocity se kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Flow rate (har second guzarne wala volume) = Av; A cross-sectional area aur v speed hai; unit m³ s⁻¹. Steady flow mein yeh har jagah barabar hai (A₁v₁ = A₂v₂), is liye velocity area ke inversely proportional hai (area kam to speed zyada).

blocks.prompt:
5.6 How do you study the variation in velocity of a fluid at different points in a hose with varying diameter?
Badalte diameter wale hose (pipe) mein mukhtalif jagahon par fluid ki velocity ka farq kaise parkhenge?
blocks.explanation: Equation of continuity A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ istemal karein. A = πd²/4 hai, is liye v₂ = v₁(d₁/d₂)²: jahan diameter chhota wahan pani tez. Har jagah flow rate ko area se taqseem karne se wahan ki speed milti hai; misal: pipe dabane se pani tez nikalta hai (5.10).

blocks.prompt:
5.7 Why does an object float or sink according to Archimedes Principle?
Archimedes principle ke mutabiq koi cheez kyun tairti ya doobti hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluid hataye gaye fluid ke weight ke barabar upthrust lagata hai. Agar cheez ka weight upthrust se zyada ho (density fluid se zyada), to doob jati hai. Agar weight upthrust ke barabar ya kam ho, to tairti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.8 How does Archimedes reportedly discover the principle that bears his name?
Riwayat ke mutabiq Archimedes ne apne naam wala principle kaise daryaft kiya?
blocks.explanation: (Chapter se bahar.) Badshah Hiero ne Archimedes se poocha ke kya us ka taaj (crown) khalis sone ka hai. Bhare tub mein baithte hue us ne dekha ke pani bahar gira, yani jism ne apne volume ke barabar pani hataya (aur woh halka mehsoos hua). Us ne samjha ke taaj aur utne hi mass ke khalis sone se hataye gaye pani ka muqabla kar ke jaanch ho sakti hai, aur kehte hain woh "Eureka!" (mil gaya) pukarta hua bahar bhaga.

blocks.prompt:
5.9 Why standing near fast moving train is dangerous? Explain briefly.
Tez chalti train ke qareeb khara hona kyun khatarnak hai? Mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation: Tez train apne aur insaan ke darmiyan hawa ko bohat tez chala deti hai. Bernoulli's principle ke mutabiq is tez hawa ka pressure kam ho jata hai, jab ke insaan ke peechhe hawa ka pressure zyada hota hai. Yeh pressure ka farq insaan ko train ki taraf dhakel deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.10 What are some potential applications of superfluidity?
Superfluidity ke kuch mumkina applications kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Superfluid helium-4 high-field (superconducting) magnets ko thanda karne (coolant) mein; helium-3 aur helium-4 advanced particle detectors mein; superfluidity ki research superconductivity samajhne mein madad deti hai. Liquid helium cryogenics, medical kaamon, leak testing aur electronic/optical products banane mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.11 Differentiate between stress, strain and Young's modulus. Write down their SI units.
Stress, strain aur Young's modulus mein farq bataein aur in ke SI units likhein.
blocks.explanation: Stress wajah hai (force per area), strain asar hai (length ka hissa-war badlao), aur Young's modulus in dono ki nisbat (ratio) hai.

rows: Shakal, volume ya length badalne ke liye per unit area force
Tensile stress per unit tensile strain

blocks.prompt:
5.1 The ratio stress/strain remains constant for small deformation. What will be effect on this ratio when the deformation made is very large?
Chhoti deformation mein stress/strain ki nisbat constant rehti hai. Bohat bari deformation par is nisbat par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Chhoti deformation (proportional limit A tak) mein Hooke's law chalta hai aur stress/strain = Young's modulus (constant).
Bohat bari deformation mein proportional limit paar ho jati hai: strain stress se zyada tezi se barhti hai, curve mud jata hai, is liye stress/strain ki nisbat kam ho jati hai aur constant nahi rehti.
Elastic limit (yield point B) ke baad deformation plastic (pakki) ho jati hai; taar wapas asal length par nahi aata, aur ultimate tensile strength C ke baad D par toot jata hai. Is liye yeh nisbat ab Young's modulus nahi rehti.

blocks.prompt:
5.2 When pure water falls on a flat glass plate, it spreads on the plate while the mercury, when falls on the same plate gets converted into small globules. Why?
Saaf pani glass plate par phail jata hai magar mercury chhoti goliyon (globules) mein badal jata hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation:
(Adhesion chapter se bahar hai.) Pani aur glass ke molecules ke darmiyan adhesive force (do mukhtalif cheezon ki kashish) pani ke apne molecules ki cohesive force se zyada hai, is liye pani glass ko geela kar ke phail jata hai.
Mercury ke atoms ki apni cohesive force glass ke saath adhesive force se kahin zyada hai, is liye mercury simat kar chhoti gol goliyan (kam se kam surface area) bana leta hai aur glass ko geela nahi karta.

blocks.prompt:
5.3 According to Bernoulli's theorem, the pressure of a fluid should remain uniform in a pipe of uniform radius. But actually, it goes on decreasing. Why is it so?
Bernoulli ke mutabiq yaksan radius wale pipe mein pressure ek jaisa rehna chahiye, magar asal mein kam hota jata hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation:
Bernoulli's theorem ideal (non-viscous) fluid maan kar banaya gaya hai. Yaksan pipe mein speed har jagah barabar hai (A₁v₁ = A₂v₂), is liye ideal fluid mein pressure bhi barabar rehta.
Asal fluids viscous hote hain: layers ke darmiyan aur pipe ki deewar ke saath friction hoti hai. Pressure energy ka kuch hissa is viscous friction ke khilaf kaam karne mein kharch ho kar heat ban jata hai, is liye pipe ke saath saath pressure kam hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.4 Why wings of an aeroplane are rounded outward while flattened inward?
Aeroplane ke wings oopar se gol (curved) aur neeche se chapte kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Wing (aerofoil) oopar se curved aur neeche se chapta hota hai taake wing ke oopar streamlines qareeb qareeb ho jayen.
Is liye oopri satah par hawa neeche ke muqable mein tez chalti hai. Bernoulli's principle ke mutabiq wing ke oopar pressure neeche se kam ho jata hai.
Yeh pressure ka farq oopar ki taraf force (lift) deta hai jo jahaz ko hawa mein sambhalti hai (5.12).

blocks.prompt:
5.5 What is the difference in real fluid, ideal fluid and superfluid? Which one of these really exits in the world? Explain.
Real fluid, ideal fluid aur superfluid mein kya farq hai? In mein se kaun waqai duniya mein mojood hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Real fluids hamare aas paas har jagah hain (pani, petrol, shahad). Superfluids bhi waqai mojood hain magar sirf lab mein bohat kam (cryogenic) temperature par, jaise helium-4 taqreeban 2 K se neeche. Ideal fluid mojood nahi; yeh sirf nazariyati (theoretical) model hai.

rows: Zero viscosity; baghair friction behta hai
Compressible (daba sakte hain); bulk modulus mehdood
Deewar par chadh jata hai (film flow), vortices bante hain
Sirf bohat kam temperature par (helium-4, helium-3)

blocks.prompt:
5.6 Why is the study of superfluids important for advancing our knowledge of low temperature physics?
Kam temperature ki physics samajhne ke liye superfluids ka mutala kyun aham hai?
blocks.explanation:
Superfluids sirf absolute zero ke qareeb bante hain, jahan maadda (matter) bilkul mukhtalif rawaiya dikhata hai: zero viscosity, bohat tang jagah se guzarna, bartan ki deewar par chadhna (film flow), na rukne wale vortices (bhanwar), normal aur superfluid hisson ka mixture, aur zyada thermal conductivity.
In effects ka mutala hamari theories ko parakhta hai ke bohat kam temperature par maadda kaise chalta hai (kuch hissa chapter se bahar: yeh bare paimane par nazar aane wale quantum effects hain).
Is se superconductivity, Bose-Einstein condensates aur shayad neutron stars jaise kam temperature ke mazameen samajh aate hain, aur behtar cryogenic technology (superconducting magnets aur particle detectors ki cooling) banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.1 Explain in detail the classification of solids with respect to atomic arrangements.
Atoms ki tarteeb ke lihaz se solids ki darja-bandi (classification) tafseel se bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Atoms, molecules ya ions ki tarteeb ke lihaz se solids teen qism ke hain.

1. Crystalline solids
• Atoms/molecules/ions ek baqaida (regular) pattern mein hote hain jo poore crystal mein dohraya jata hai (long-range order).
• Aksar metals aur ceramics crystalline hain; in ki banawat X-ray diffraction (XRD) aur TEM se dekhi jati hai.
• Atoms ruke hue nahi; har atom ek fixed point ke gird vibrate karta hai aur temperature barhne se amplitude barhta hai. Cohesive forces in vibrations ke bawajood tarteeb qaim rakhti hain.
• Ek khaas temperature par vibrations structure tor deti hain aur solid achanak pighal jata hai, is liye crystalline solid ka melting point muqarrar (definite) hota hai.
• Misalein: quartz, calcite, cheeni, mica, diamond, sodium chloride, copper.

2. Amorphous (glassy) solids
• Amorphous ka matlab hai be-shakal: molecules ki koi baqaida tarteeb nahi; yeh aise liquids ki tarah hain jin ki be-tarteeb banawat jam gayi ho.
• Garam karne par aahista aahista naram hote hain (glass pehle paste aur phir taqreeban 800 °C par bohat gaarha liquid), is liye in ka melting point muqarrar nahi.
• Misalein: aam glass, plastic, fused silica.

3. Polymeric solids
• In ki banawat tarteeb aur be-tarteebi ke darmiyan hai; yeh jazvi (partially) crystalline hain.
• Yeh polymerization se bante hain: saada molecules mil kar bohat lambi chain wale molecules ya 3-D structures banate hain.
• In mein carbon oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen waghera ke saath juda hota hai; yeh halke (kam specific gravity) magar wazan ke muqable mein mazboot hote hain.
• Misalein: polythene, polystyrene, nylon, plastics, rubber (C₅H₈)ₙ, wool.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: crystalline = fauj ki qataarein (har cheez tarteeb mein), amorphous = mele ka hujoom (koi tarteeb nahi), polymer = lambi zanjeerein (kuch tarteeb, kuch be-tarteebi).

blocks.prompt:
5.2 Define strain energy and derive mathematical relation for it.
Strain energy ki tareef karein aur is ka mathematical relation derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Strain energy: jab force se jism deform hota hai to elastic restoring force ke khilaf kaam hota hai. Yeh kaam jism mein potential energy ki shakal mein jama ho jata hai; isay strain (elastic potential) energy kehte hain.

Derivation:
Spring (ya taar) ko force F se Δx extension tak khencha jaye. Elastic limit ke andar extension ∝ force, is liye force 0 se F tak barabar barhti hai.
Average force = (0 + F)/2 = ½F
Work = average force × faasla
W = ½F × Δx ...(1)
Hooke's law: F = kΔx, is liye
W = ½(kΔx)(Δx) = ½kΔx²
Yeh kaam strain energy ban kar jama hota hai:
E = ½FΔx = ½kΔx²
Force-extension graph par yeh line ke neeche triangle OPQ ka area hai.

Per unit volume strain energy:
Length L, area A aur extension ΔL wali taar ka volume = AL, is liye
U = ½ FΔL/(AL) = ½ (F/A)(ΔL/L)
U = ½ × stress × strain
Kyun ke F/A = Y(ΔL/L),
U = ½ Y (ΔL/L)²

blocks.prompt:
5.3 What is Archimedes' principle? Explain it in detail for finding upthrust.
Archimedes' principle kya hai? Upthrust maloom karne ke liye tafseel se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Archimedes' principle: jab koi cheez kisi liquid mein poori ya kuch dooobi ho, to us par oopar ki taraf upthrust lagti hai jo us ke hataye gaye liquid ke weight ke barabar hoti hai.

Upthrust maloom karna:
Area A aur height h wala solid cylinder density ρ wale liquid mein poora dooba hai. Oopri satah gehrai h₁ par aur nichli satah h₂ par hai, to h₂ − h₁ = h.
Oopri satah par pressure: P₁ = ρgh₁
Nichli satah par pressure: P₂ = ρgh₂
Oopar wali satah par neeche ki force: F₁ = P₁A = ρgh₁A
Neeche wali satah par oopar ki force: F₂ = P₂A = ρgh₂A
h₂ > h₁, is liye F₂ > F₁. Net oopar ki force (upthrust):
F = F₂ − F₁ = ρgA(h₂ − h₁) = ρgAh
Ah = V = cylinder ka volume = hataye gaye liquid ka volume, is liye
Upthrust = ρgV = hataye gaye liquid ka weight.
Yahi Archimedes' principle hai. Isi upthrust ki wajah se liquid mein cheez ka weight kam lagta hai (apparent loss of weight). Yeh gases par bhi lagu hai.
Misal: 10 cm ka cube pani mein: V = 1 × 10⁻³ m³, upthrust = 1000 × 9.8 × 1 × 10⁻³ = 9.8 N.
Applications: ships aur boats ka tairna, submarine, hot-air balloon.

blocks.prompt:
5.4 Justify that mass remains conserved when a fluid flows through a pipe.
Sabit karein ke pipe mein fluid behne par mass mehfooz (conserved) rehta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Badalte cross-section wale pipe mein fluid ka steady flow lein.
Chhote waqt Δt mein nichle sire (area A₁, speed v₁) se dakhil hone wala fluid Δx₁ = v₁Δt faasla chalta hai.
Dakhil hone wala volume = A₁Δx₁ = A₁v₁Δt
Dakhil hone wala mass: Δm₁ = ρ₁A₁v₁Δt
Usi waqt mein oopri sire (area A₂, speed v₂, density ρ₂) se nikalne wala mass:
Δm₂ = ρ₂A₂v₂Δt
Steady flow mein fluid pipe ke andar kahin jama ya ghaib nahi hota. Is liye jitna mass dakhil hua, utna hi nikla:
Δm₁ = Δm₂
ρ₁A₁v₁Δt = ρ₂A₂v₂Δt
ρ₁A₁v₁ = ρ₂A₂v₂ (equation of continuity)
Incompressible fluid mein ρ₁ = ρ₂, is liye A₁v₁ = A₂v₂: andar aane ka rate = bahar jane ka rate.
Yani equation of continuity mass ke conservation ka qanoon hai: pipe mein behte hue mass mehfooz rehta hai. Jahan pipe tang hai wahan fluid tez chalta hai taake har hisse se har second utna hi mass guzre.

blocks.prompt:
5.5 Explain the term superfluidity.
Superfluidity ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Superfluidity: fluid ki woh khasiyat jis mein us ki viscosity zero ho, yani woh baghair friction ke behe. Aisi cheez superfluid kehlati hai; yeh baghair kinetic energy khoye behti hai.

Kaise banti hai: lab mein kuch cheezein cryogenic (bohat thande) temperature par, absolute zero se zara oopar, superfluid banti hain; misal helium-4 apne boiling point (4 K, −269 °C) se chand degree neeche superfluid ban jati hai.

Khasiyaat:
• Bohat tang jagah se baghair rukawat guzarti hai; ek dafa chal pare to rukawaton ke paas se guzarti rehti hai.
• Gravity ke khilaf: bartan ki deewar par chadh kar bahar nikal jati hai (film flow), balke deewar ke paar bhi.
• Hilane par na rukne wale vortices (bhanwar) banti hai; bartan ghumayen to andar ka liquid saakit rehta hai.
• Normal aur superfluid hisson ka mixture; temperature jitna kam, superfluid hissa utna zyada.
• Kuch superfluids ki thermal conductivity zyada aur compressibility badalti rehti hai.
• Superfluidity aur superconductivity alag hain: helium-3 aur helium-4 bijli conduct nahi karte.

Misalein: superfluid helium-4 aur helium-3, kuch Bose-Einstein condensates, rubidium-85, lithium-6 atoms (50 nK par), sodium, shayad neutron stars ka andar.

Applications: high-field magnets ki cooling (helium-4), particle detectors, superconductivity ki research.

blocks.prompt:
5.6 State and derive equation of continuity.
Equation of continuity bayan karein aur derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: pipe ke kisi bhi point par cross-sectional area aur fluid ki speed ka hasil-e-zarb (Av) constant rehta hai. Yeh constant har second behne wala volume (flow rate) hai:
Av = constant

Derivation:
Badalte size wale pipe mein fluid ka steady flow lein.
Chhote waqt Δt mein nichle sire (area A₁) par fluid speed v₁ se faasla tay karta hai:
Δx₁ = v₁Δt
Andar aane wala volume: V = A₁Δx₁ = A₁v₁Δt
Density ρ₁ ho to andar aane wala mass:
Δm₁ = ρ₁A₁v₁Δt
Isi tarah usi waqt mein oopri sire (area A₂, speed v₂, density ρ₂) se nikalne wala mass:
Δm₂ = ρ₂A₂v₂Δt
Steady flow mein mass mehfooz rehta hai:
Δm₁ = Δm₂
ρ₁A₁v₁Δt = ρ₂A₂v₂Δt
ρ₁A₁v₁ = ρ₂A₂v₂
Yeh equation of continuity hai. Incompressible fluid mein density constant (ρ₁ = ρ₂), is liye
A₁v₁ = A₂v₂
Yani steady flow mein andar aane ka rate bahar jane ke rate ke barabar hai. Pipe jahan tang ho wahan speed zyada (pipe dabane se pani tez nikalta hai).

blocks.prompt:
5.7 State and prove Bernoulli's equation.
Bernoulli's equation bayan karein aur sabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: ideal (incompressible, non-viscous) fluid ke steady flow mein streamline ke har point par pressure, per unit volume kinetic energy aur per unit volume potential energy ka majmua constant rehta hai:
P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant

Saboot:
Badalte cross-section aur height wale pipe mein fluid behta hai. Oopri sire par: pressure P₁, area A₁, speed v₁, height h₁. Nichle sire par: P₂, A₂, v₂, h₂.
Oopri sire par fluid ko Δx₁ dhakelne mein kaam:
W₁ = F₁Δx₁ = P₁A₁Δx₁
Nichle sire par fluid ke khilaf kaam:
W₂ = −P₂A₂Δx₂
Net kaam: W = P₁A₁Δx₁ − P₂A₂Δx₂
Waqt t mein Δx₁ = v₁t aur Δx₂ = v₂t, is liye W = P₁A₁v₁t − P₂A₂v₂t
Continuity se A₁v₁t = A₂v₂t = V (volume), is liye
W = (P₁ − P₂)V = (P₁ − P₂)m/ρ
Yeh kaam fluid ki K.E. aur gravitational P.E. badalta hai:
ΔK.E. = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁²
ΔP.E. = mgh₂ − mgh₁
Energy ke conservation se:
(P₁ − P₂)m/ρ = ½mv₂² − ½mv₁² + mgh₂ − mgh₁
ρ/m se zarb de kar tarteeb dein:
P₁ + ½ρv₁² + ρgh₁ = P₂ + ½ρv₂² + ρgh₂
ya P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant
Yahi Bernoulli's equation hai. Horizontal pipe mein P + ½ρv² = constant: jahan speed zyada, wahan pressure kam.

blocks.prompt:
5.8 Give some practical equations of Bernoulli's equation.
Bernoulli's equation ke kuch amli (practical) applications bataein.
blocks.explanation:
(Sawal ka matlab Bernoulli's equation ke amli applications hai.)
1. Aeroplane wings: curved oopri satah par hawa tez, is liye oopar pressure kam aur neeche zyada; yeh farq lift deta hai.
2. Ball ka swing: ghoomti (ya ek taraf se chikni) ball ke ek taraf hawa tez aur doosri taraf aahista; pressure ka farq side ki force (Magnus effect) deta hai aur ball mud jati hai.
3. Filter pump: pani ki dhaar tang jagah se tez guzarti hai, pressure gir jata hai aur side tube se hawa andar khinchti hai.
4. Carburetor: Venturi duct mein tez hawa kam pressure banati hai jo petrol ke bukharat (vapour) ko hawa mein khench leti hai.
5. Paint sprayer / perfume atomizer: tube ke oopar tez hawa pressure kam karti hai, atmospheric pressure liquid ko oopar dhakelta hai aur woh spray ho jata hai.
6. Venturi meter: horizontal pipe mein P₁ − P₂ = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²); v₁ chhor kar P₁ − P₂ = ½ρv₂² (Venturi relation); is se liquid ke flow ki speed naapte hain.
7. Torricelli's theorem: surface se (h₁ − h₂) gehrai wale soorakh se nikalne ki speed v = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)), utni hi jitni us oonchai se girne wali cheez ki.
Aur: hawa chimney ke oopar se guzre to wahan pressure kam hota hai aur dhuan behtar nikalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal "practical equations of Bernoulli's equation" chhapa hai; is ka matlab Bernoulli's equation ke practical applications (istemal) hai, jaise 5.12 mein.

blocks.prompt:
5.9 Define terminal velocity of a body and show that terminal velocity is directly proportional to the square of radius of the body.
Terminal velocity ki tareef karein aur dikhayein ke terminal velocity jism ke radius ke square ke directly proportional hai.
blocks.explanation:
Terminal velocity: fluid mein girti cheez ki woh constant (zyada se zyada) velocity jab oopar ki drag force us ke weight ke barabar ho jaye aur net force zero ho.

Derivation:
Radius r aur density ρ wala gol qatra viscosity η wale fluid mein girta hai. Gravity usay tez karti hai aur speed ke saath oopar ki drag force barhti hai.
Net force = weight − drag force
Stokes' law: drag force F = 6πηrv.
Jab drag weight ke barabar ho, net force zero aur qatra constant speed vₜ se girta hai:
0 = mg − 6πηrvₜ
vₜ = mg/(6πηr)
Qatre ka mass m = ρV = ρ(4/3)πr³, is liye
vₜ = (4/3)πr³ρg/(6πηr)
vₜ = 2gr²ρ/(9η)
Kisi fluid (η) aur cheez (ρ) ke liye 2gρ/(9η) constant hai, is liye
vₜ ∝ r²
Yani terminal velocity radius ke square ke directly proportional hai: bare qatre tez girte hain (r dugna to vₜ chaar guna).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Barish ka bara qatra chhote qatre se tez girta hai, aur dhund (fog) ke nanhe qatre hawa mein lataktay rehte hain, kyun ke vₜ ∝ r²: radius bohat chhota ho to terminal velocity bhi bohat kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.1 A steel wire of length 2 meters and cross-sectional area 2 × 10⁻⁶ m² is stretched by a force of 400 N. If the Young's modulus of steel is 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻², calculate the extension of the wire. (Ans: 0.002 m)
2 m lambi aur 2 × 10⁻⁶ m² area wali steel ki taar 400 N force se khenchi jati hai. Steel ka Young's modulus 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻² hai; taar ki extension maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 2 m, A = 2 × 10⁻⁶ m², F = 400 N, Y = 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²
Maloom karna: extension ΔL = ?
Formula: Y = (F/A)/(ΔL/L), is liye ΔL = FL/(AY)
Qeematein: ΔL = (400 N × 2 m)/(2 × 10⁻⁶ m² × 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²)
ΔL = 800/(4 × 10⁵) m
ΔL = 2 × 10⁻³ m = 0.002 m
Jawab: extension = 0.002 m (kitab ke jawab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
5.2 A spring with a spring constant 200 N m⁻¹ is stretched by 0.5 m. Find the elastic P.E. stored in the spring. (Ans: 25 J)
200 N m⁻¹ spring constant wala spring 0.5 m khencha jata hai. Spring mein jama elastic P.E. maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: k = 200 N m⁻¹, Δx = 0.5 m
Maloom karna: elastic P.E. E = ?
Formula: E = ½kΔx²
Qeematein: E = ½ × 200 N m⁻¹ × (0.5 m)²
E = 100 × 0.25 J
E = 25 J
Jawab: elastic P.E. = 25 J (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
5.3 A copper wire of length 3 meters and cross-sectional area of 1 × 10⁻⁴ m² is subjected to a force of 500 N. Calculate the stress and strain produced in the wire. (Ans: 5 × 10⁶ N m⁻², 0.00455)
3 m lambi aur 1 × 10⁻⁴ m² area wali copper ki taar par 500 N force lagti hai. Taar mein paida hone wala stress aur strain maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 3 m, A = 1 × 10⁻⁴ m², F = 500 N
Copper ka Young's modulus (sawal mein nahi diya; Table 5.1 se): Y = 110 × 10⁹ N m⁻² = 1.1 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²
Maloom karna: stress σ = ?, strain ε = ?
(i) Stress: σ = F/A = 500 N/(1 × 10⁻⁴ m²)
σ = 5 × 10⁶ N m⁻²
(ii) Strain: Y = σ/ε se ε = σ/Y
ε = (5 × 10⁶ N m⁻²)/(1.1 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²)
ε = 4.55 × 10⁻⁵ (koi unit nahi)
(Extension: ΔL = εL = 4.55 × 10⁻⁵ × 3 m = 1.36 × 10⁻⁴ m)
Jawab: stress = 5 × 10⁶ N m⁻², strain = 4.55 × 10⁻⁵ = 0.0000455.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab strain 0.00455 chhapti hai. Strain ke liye copper ka Young's modulus chahiye jo sawal mein nahi diya; Y = 1.1 × 10¹¹ N m⁻² (Table 5.1) aur chhape hue area 1 × 10⁻⁴ m² se strain = 5 × 10⁶/1.1 × 10¹¹ = 4.55 × 10⁻⁵ (0.0000455) aata hai, yani 100 guna chhota. Kitab ka 0.00455 tab aata jab area 1 × 10⁻⁶ m² hota (stress 5 × 10⁸ N m⁻²). Kitab mein stress ke jawab ki power saaf nahi parhi jati (6 ya 8).

blocks.prompt:
5.4 A block of wood of mass 10 kg and density of 600 kg m⁻³ is floating in water. Calculate the buoyant force acting on the block. (Density of water = 1000 kg m⁻³.) (Ans: 98 N)
10 kg mass aur 600 kg m⁻³ density wala lakri ka block pani mein tair raha hai. Block par buoyant force maloom karein. (Pani ki density = 1000 kg m⁻³.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m = 10 kg, ρ(lakri) = 600 kg m⁻³, ρ(pani) = 1000 kg m⁻³, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Maloom karna: buoyant force F = ?
ρ(lakri) < ρ(pani), is liye block tairta hai. Tairti cheez ke liye (principle of floatation):
Buoyant force = block ka weight
F = mg = 10 kg × 9.8 m s⁻²
F = 98 N
Jaanch: block ka volume V = m/ρ = 10/600 = 0.0167 m³; pani ke andar volume = F/(ρ(pani)g) = 98/(1000 × 9.8) = 0.01 m³, yani block ka 60% pani mein dooba hai.
Jawab: buoyant force = 98 N (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Density 600 aur pani 1000 hai, is liye block ka 600/1000 = 60% hissa pani mein doobta hai. Tairti cheez par upthrust hamesha us ke apne weight ke barabar hota hai, chahe woh kitni bhi doobi ho.

blocks.prompt:
5.5 Water flows through a pipe with a diameter of 0.05 m at a velocity of 2 m s⁻¹. If the pipe narrows to a diameter of 0.03 m, Calculate the velocity of water at narrow section. (Ans: 5.56 m s⁻¹)
0.05 m diameter wale pipe mein pani 2 m s⁻¹ se behta hai. Pipe ka diameter 0.03 m reh jaye to tang hisse mein pani ki velocity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: d₁ = 0.05 m, v₁ = 2 m s⁻¹, d₂ = 0.03 m
Maloom karna: v₂ = ?
Formula (equation of continuity): A₁v₁ = A₂v₂, aur A = πd²/4
Is liye v₂ = v₁(A₁/A₂) = v₁(d₁/d₂)²
Qeematein: v₂ = 2 m s⁻¹ × (0.05/0.03)²
v₂ = 2 × (1.667)² m s⁻¹ = 2 × 2.778 m s⁻¹
v₂ = 5.56 m s⁻¹
Jawab: tang hisse mein velocity = 5.56 m s⁻¹ (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
5.6 Water flows through a horizontal pipe with a velocity of 3 m s⁻¹ and pressure of 200,000 Pa at point 1. At the nozzle (point 2), the pressure decreases to atmospheric pressure 101,300 Pa and the velocity increases to 14 m s⁻¹. Calculate the velocity of the water exiting the nozzle. (Ans: 14.3 m s⁻¹)
Horizontal pipe mein point 1 par pani ki velocity 3 m s⁻¹ aur pressure 200,000 Pa hai. Nozzle (point 2) par pressure atmospheric 101,300 Pa reh jata hai. Nozzle se nikalte pani ki velocity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: v₁ = 3 m s⁻¹, P₁ = 200,000 Pa, P₂ = 101,300 Pa, ρ(pani) = 1000 kg m⁻³, pipe horizontal (h₁ = h₂)
Maloom karna: v₂ = ?
Formula (Bernoulli, horizontal pipe): P₁ + ½ρv₁² = P₂ + ½ρv₂²
Is liye v₂² = v₁² + 2(P₁ − P₂)/ρ
Qeematein: v₂² = (3 m s⁻¹)² + 2(200,000 − 101,300) Pa/(1000 kg m⁻³)
v₂² = 9 + 2 × 98,700/1000
v₂² = 9 + 197.4 = 206.4 m² s⁻²
v₂ = √206.4 m s⁻¹ = 14.37 m s⁻¹
Jawab: nozzle par velocity ≈ 14.4 m s⁻¹ (14.37; kitab isay 14.3 likhti hai, aur sawal mein "14 m s⁻¹" bhi yahi qeemat gol ki hui hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sawal mein "velocity increases to 14 m s⁻¹" likha hai aur phir wahi velocity poochi gayi hai; isay jawab ka andaza samjhein. Asal hisaab Bernoulli se hota hai: pressure ka farq (98,700 Pa) pani ki kinetic energy barhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5.7 A tank filled with water has a hole at a depth of 5 m from the water surface. Calculate the velocity of water flowing out of the hole. (Ans: 9.9 m s⁻¹)
Pani se bhare tank mein surface se 5 m gehrai par soorakh hai. Soorakh se nikalte pani ki velocity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: surface se gehrai (h₁ − h₂) = 5 m, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Maloom karna: nikalne ki speed v = ?
Formula (Torricelli's theorem): v = √(2g(h₁ − h₂))
Qeematein: v = √(2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × 5 m)
v = √98 m s⁻¹
v = 9.9 m s⁻¹
Jawab: pani ki velocity = 9.9 m s⁻¹ (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
5.8 Calculate the terminal velocity of a spherical raindrop with a radius 0.5 mm falling through air. (Ans: 9.90 m s⁻¹)
0.5 mm radius wala gol barish ka qatra hawa mein girta hai. Us ki terminal velocity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: r = 0.5 mm = 5 × 10⁻⁴ m, ρ(pani) = 1000 kg m⁻³, g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Hawa ki viscosity (sawal mein nahi di; Example 5.5 wali): η = 19 × 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹
Maloom karna: terminal velocity vₜ = ?
Formula (Stokes' law): vₜ = 2gr²ρ/(9η)
Qeematein: vₜ = (2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × (5 × 10⁻⁴ m)² × 1000 kg m⁻³)/(9 × 19 × 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹)
Oopar wala hissa = 2 × 9.8 × 2.5 × 10⁻⁷ × 1000 = 4.9 × 10⁻³
Neeche wala hissa = 9 × 19 × 10⁻⁶ = 1.71 × 10⁻⁴
vₜ = 4.9 × 10⁻³/1.71 × 10⁻⁴ m s⁻¹
vₜ ≈ 28.7 m s⁻¹
Jawab: Stokes' law se terminal velocity ≈ 28.7 m s⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 9.90 m s⁻¹ chhapti hai jo chapter ke data se nahi nikalta. Sawal mein na pani ki density di hai na hawa ki viscosity; ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³ aur η = 19 × 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ (Example 5.5) se vₜ = 2gr²ρ/(9η) ≈ 28.7 m s⁻¹ aata hai. (Chapter se bahar: Stokes' law sirf aahista harkat par lagta hai, is liye asal 0.5 mm qatra kahin aahista, taqreeban 4 m s⁻¹ se girta hai.)
